lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: I was thinking of getting a gift for Yuni.

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: What do you think I should get her?
You're the greatest gift she can ever have.
A new set of handcuffs and some whips.

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: You're sweet ♡

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: I'm sure that is how Yuni feels,

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: which brings a smile to my face.

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: Yuni already has plenty of those.

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: Sure, if I bought new ones for her, she'd use them plenty, but

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: I want to get her something special.

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: Ah, I thought of a great gift.
What is it?

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: Curious, eh?

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: I'll need a human volunteer and a big box.

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: First, the human

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: goes inside the box.

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: Oh, yeah! A ribbon around their neck would be a nice touch too ♡

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: Later, when Yuni opens the box,

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: she'll be so thrilled!
And who's the volunteer going to be?

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: The one who's chatting with me

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: on blabla right now.

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: Commander.

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: You'll do me a solid, won't you?

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: Come to the club tonight.

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: I'll be waiting ♡
